notes.title: Patch Notes: 13.03 to 18.02
notes.notes:
It's been a little while since my last proper patch notes update. Each update to [i]The 52 Fragments[/i] often includes unseen bug fixes, however update 18.2 has quite a few. I am consolidating all of the patch notes from 13.03 to current.

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where returning to the main menu will lock the cursor.
[*] Fixed several issues with rendering realtime lights, particularly pixel lights.
[*] Fixed a bug where the 13th fragment would not detect a CD drive properly. A related bug where the game would not detect a floppy drive correctly on some hardware architecture is currently determined to be unfixable due to limitations of the [i]ManagementObjectSearcher[/i] in [i]System.Management[/i], a part of .NET.
[*] Made the "dark" version of Fragment 16 about 15% sadder.
[*] Fixed a bug which would cause the first window in the 13th fragment to not spawn.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Speed of Light object in Fragment 11 would fling the player into the void (which was pretty hilarious, tbh)
[*] Fixed a bug regarding file parsing in Fragment 03.
[*] Fixed a bug causing gimbal lock in Fragment 10.
[*] Fixed a couple of sound bugs.
[/list]

[b]Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Added and removed many objects across multiple fragments as a result of ███ █████.
[*] Added easter eggs, including one specific to the youtuber Shesez, who is nonetheless unlikely to play my game.
[*] Removed Fragment 14 in its entirety based on the cumulative votes of participants of the phone survey in Fragment 12.
[*] Implemented multiple secret 'codes' into Fragment 4 which have various effects, such as code 081026.
[/list]

[b]Framework changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Re-implemented Mono backend from IL2CPP in order to allow [i]System.Management[/i] to function properly, as, per Unity, "IL2CPP does not support System.Configuration.ConfigurationManager".
[*] Major changes to the character controller set to allow for more types of controllers to interface with it and, hopefully, provide full controller support soon.
[/list]

[b]Some small metrics[/b]
[list]
[*] The Computer in Fragment 02 has been dealt a cumulative 7,314 units of pain.
[*] 6,322 proposals have been approved, and 5,981 have been rejected.
[*] Players have traveled a cumulative 1.2 trillion kilometers in Fragment 11.
[*] During the phone survey portion of Fragment 12, I personally received 48 phone calls.
[*] The most common fear as reported by players is 'spiders', followed closely by 'being alone'.
[/list]
